To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the cold tolerance of 6 varieties of savoy at seedling stage was assessed by multiple physiological indexes and the cold tolerance of savoy cultivar was evaluated by relative electric conductivity and MDA content.
the cold resistance of 4 varieties(Tadiwu 6, Tadiwu1, Huiwu 6 and Tadiwu2) was better than that of Tadiwu 5 and Tadiwu3.
the cold tolerance of 6 savoys can be assessed by multiple physiological indices and the cold tolerance can be divided into four levels.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the cold tolerance of savoy at seedling stage, which is of great significance for improving the quality and cold resistance of savoys.
the physiological characteristics of six savoy varieties under different temperatures, which is of great significance for improving the cold resistance of the savoy varieties.

the cold resistance evaluation of savoy cultivar at seedling stage, which can provide a theoretical reference for the selection of savoy cultivaras with good cold resistance and the breeding of new cultivar with high cold resistance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the evaluation of cold resistance in savoy seedlings should be carried out by multiple indexes and the relative values of the physiological indexes at low temperature to the normal temperature.
Tadiwu 2 is suitable for planting in the cold region of the north of China.
the relative electric conductivity and the relative MDA content of leaves were the most suitable indexes for assessing cold tolerance of savoy cultivar at seedling stage.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cold resistance evaluation of savoy cultivar could be used for breeding of savoy varieties with high cold resistance.

the relative electric conductivity, relative MDA content and LT50 could be used as indexes to evaluate cold tolerance of savoy seedling, the relative MDA content was more sensitive to cold stress, and the relative electric conductivity was less sensitive.
the cold resistance of 5 cultivars of Tadiwu series was better than that of Huiwu 6.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the cold tolerance of savoy can be assessed by relative electric conductivity and MDA content, and that the cold tolerance at seedlings stage is consistent with that at adult stage, which can be used as the basis for the evaluation of cold tolerance of savoys at adult stage.
the cold tolerance of savoy can be evaluated by multiple indexes at seedling stage, and Tadiwu6 and Huiwul have good cold tolerance.
the relative electric conductivity, relative MDA content and relative SOD activity are suitable indexes for evaluating the cold tolerance of savoy seedling at seedling stage.
